Name: Sleepless in Stardew
Author: instafluff
Description:
[size=5][b]Sleepless in Stardew
[/b][/size]
The Stardew Valley Late-Night Get-More-Done Sleep-less Insomniac Productivity Powernap Mod!
Just add this mod and extend your sleep time to 6am instead of 2am.

Now with Clock Click Time Toggle and Multiplayer support! Click the clock to freeze/unfreeze time!

[size=5][b]Install[/b][/size][list=1]
[*][url=https://smapi.io/]Install the latest version of SMAPI[/url].
[*]Download the Sleepless in Stardew mod and unzip it into Stardew Valley/Mods.
[*]Run the game using SMAPI.
[/list]
[size=5][b]FAQ[/b]
[/size][i][b][size=3]
Will this break my game save?
[/size][/b][/i]Nope! It just gives you an extra 4 hours to be more productive per day.

[i][b][size=3]Does this affect the in-game events?
[/size][/b][/i]Nope!

[i][b][size=3]What happens if I stay up past 6am?
[/size][/b][/i]You will pass out and lose stuff so be careful!

[i][b][size=3]Are my stats going to be affected?
[/size][/b][/i]Nope! This mod works by simply manipulating the in-game world time and nothing else about your gameplay will be different.

[i][b][size=3]What about my pet's happiness?
[/size][/b][/i]Your pet will love you just the same. <3

[i][b][size=3]Will this work in Multiplayer?
[/size][/b][/i]As of version 1.6.0, this works! And only the host needs the mod for this to work!
